title: Final Answer
description: Essential Criteria: The student must state that the angular momentum vector is nearly perpendicular to the long axis of the grain.

title: Inertia Relationship
description: Important Criteria: The student should explain the relationship between the principal moments of inertia and the angular velocities.

title: Thermal Equilibrium
description: Important Criteria: The student must mention that the system is in thermal equilibrium and how it affects angular momentum.

title: Mathematical Justification
description: Important Criteria: The student should provide a mathematical justification for the relationship between angular momentum and the moments of inertia.

title: Sign Mistakes
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should avoid sign mistakes in the angular momentum calculations.
